title: Verify Roulette selectors and extended animation window
changes: Extend the scoped ordinary octonary recovery proof with direct selector 0 and 1 observations and a 1,200-frame paired Roulette window.
validation: A snapshot-only selector-offset watch on the authenticated IN-19 Roulette seed observes octonary selector 0 at 0x086cc154 on frame 12251 and passes a 600-frame e128 Wine raw/managed pair. Evidence: target/validation/units/e128-6cc124-selector-watch-pair-vkj66o3u/.

A second snapshot watch restricted to selector offsets 1 and 2 observes selector 1 at 0x086cc156 on frame 12276. The e128 Wine native raw/managed pair passes 1,200 frames through 13160 with full state, guest clock, central/wide images, OAM, dispatch and all five audio streams equal every frame; 5,831 owner source bytes served. Guarded inputs pass and successful runtime scratch is removed. Evidence: target/validation/units/e128-6cc124-late-selector-pair-nqbg2k88/.
limitations: The snapshot-only tests reuse the generic catalog watch trigger and its legacy root label; the watched offsets and counters are octonary-specific. Selector 2, all lists/frames, action completion, other consumers, Linux, USA, native Windows and performance remain separate.
